title: "RFM Analysis: Recency, Frequency, Monetary Segmentation Explained"

facts.fact: Each RFM score (recency, frequency, monetary) runs from 1 to 5, and the three digits combine into a code that places a customer in a named segment.
facts.quote: Each score runs from 1 to 5, and the three digits combine into a code that places the customer in a named segment

facts.fact: Braze says the common RFM method splits customers on each metric into five equal groups (quintiles), with the top 20% scoring 5.
facts.quote: splits them into five equal groups, quintiles, where the top 20% score 5

facts.fact: Bloomreach says scoring each RFM metric from 1 to 5 gives 125 possible score combinations.
facts.quote: Scoring each metric from 1 to 5 gives 125 possible score combinations (5 x 5 x 5)

facts.fact: Bloomreach recommends 12 to 24 months or more of purchase data for RFM analysis.
facts.quote: Bloomreach recommends 12 to 24 months or more of purchase data
Putler lists 11 segments, while Oracle's model uses 6 personas assigned from recency and frequency alone.

facts.fact: Oracle's RFM model uses 6 personas assigned from recency and frequency alone.
facts.quote: Oracle's model uses 6 personas assigned from recency and frequency alone

facts.fact: Bloomreach suggests manual frequency bands of 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 or more orders when frequency quantiles are uneven.
facts.quote: suggests manual bands such as 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 or more orders in that case

facts.fact: Bloomreach says fixed RFM thresholds may need monthly readjustment.
facts.quote: Bloomreach says fixed thresholds may need monthly readjustment

facts.fact: The article recommends grouping the 125 RFM codes into 6 to 11 named segments, each with a rule on the three scores.
facts.quote: Group them into 6 to 11 segments, each with a rule on the three scores.
